newly_supplied_choices.bounds_and_scales: The coefficient box and optimization scales are new explicit choices; they were not recoverable from the source.
newly_supplied_choices.dealiasing: No extra filter: the same pointwise collocation product w*ws is used in plant and residual.
newly_supplied_choices.timing: Compute command and preupdate predictions; measure rate; assimilate causal complete-feature difference; apply already-selected command for one RK4 interval. New coefficients affect the next command.
newly_supplied_choices.actuation: Unconstrained distributed input at all 64 grid points. No actuator clipping.
newly_supplied_choices.memory: Zero 4x4 complete-feature-rate moment; exponential update with spatial averaging and beta=exp(-dt/memory_time).
newly_supplied_choices.sensor: Only wt receives independent Gaussian noise. State and spatial derivative channels are exact; true clean rates are evaluator-only.
newly_supplied_choices.final_sample: Record the terminal state but exclude its unapplied command from metrics and effort integration.
